text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I have all the info on the contenders right in the palm of my hand.
Both pace and race development are just as expected.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to them, the simulations were supposed to be perfect...
And yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh...! Bad, bad, bad!
Get out of the way! Move, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Wait, what is happening here...?! Everyone's in total chaos...! In a situation like this—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (—The race is being repainted in her colors.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even though I checked everything.
I predicted how the race would unfold,
and calculated exactly how many seconds my spurt would last.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —The girl from back then ruined everything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's still a month until the Derby.
—A whole month left.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Let's get moving right away.
The more time we have to prepare, the better."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—Next time, I'll make the race mine.
The 'Japanese Derby' will be the one.”
